meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品网址或一段文案变成产品发布宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有产品要上线,需要一条宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product URL or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product to launch and need a promo video

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或一句简介,一步步做成产品发布/宣传视频:先抓取站点和品牌素材,定设计与分镜脚本,再逐帧生成画面,最后渲染出 renders/video.mp4;中途在几个节点停下来等你确认。
howto.when: 当你想营销、发布或推广某个产品时触发;任何商业网址的默认处理路径。网站导览/展示类需求也走这里;意图不明确时会先转去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个产品网址做成一支发布视频
say.note: 会先抓取站点和品牌素材,再继续往下走

say.text: 照我粘贴的这段脚本做一支宣传片
用这份产品简介做宣传视频,先给我看分镜
say.note: 分镜会作为提案提交给你审核

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: captures site and brand assets, drafts storyboard and script, builds each frame, renders renders/video.mp4. It pauses for your review at set gates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, or promote a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours and showcases route here too; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this product URL into a launch video
